_note: NSE CASH-MARKET TRADING HOLIDAYS. A WRONGLY LISTED HOLIDAY SILENTLY SUPPRESSES A REAL SESSION'S AUTOMATIC CLOSE MARK — the desk says the market is shut, the catch-up door and the 15:31 close door both refuse, and nothing on screen looks broken. Only a RECORDED DIFF against NSE's own holiday-master may add a row here, and `verified_at` / `verified_against` must be rewritten by the session that ran the fetch, never copied. CLEARING HOLIDAYS ARE NOT TRADING HOLIDAYS and are deliberately absent: NSE publishes ?type=trading and ?type=clearing separately, a clearing holiday is a day the market is OPEN and settlement is shut, and conflating the two once cancelled a real session (2026-08-26, Id-E-Milad, a clearing holiday copied into a trading list). The list STOPS at `year`: a date in any other year is UNKNOWN, not a holiday, so the weekday behaviour survives and `tests/nse-holidays.test.ts`'s year guard goes red the moment the app's own IST year passes it. Source: https://www.nseindia.com/api/holiday-master?type=trading (segment CM).
